items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a gerbe morphism of algebraic stacks is a universal homeomorphism (author lemma at source lines 6616-6619, label lemma-gerbe-bijection-points). The proof (source lines 6624-6648) reduces to the map on topological spaces by base change, proves surjectivity there from the local existence of objects and injectivity from the local existence of isomorphisms supplied by the gerbe condition, and obtains openness from the facts that the morphism is fppf and that flat morphisms of finite presentation are open (proof lines 6624-6647). The verification of bijectivity on points through the two gerbe clauses and the openness step are the content. H3.
